name: SJV Awards Program
summary: Competitive awards for short-term bird and habitat conservation projects in the Sonoran Joint Venture region. The 2026 priorities include habitat restoration, Indigenous stewardship, monitoring and partnership capacity.

geography.label: southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico

status.quote: September 24 - Proposals must be received by the Sonoran Joint Venture no later than midnight, Pacific Daylight time.

geography.quote: The Sonoran Joint Venture is a regional partnership working to conserve the unique birds and habitats of the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico.

access.quote: Put all proposal components into a single Word document or PDF (cover sheet, project narrative, budget, and, if relevant, letters of support). Email the document to the Sonoran Joint Venture.

window.quote: September 10 - Request for Proposals made available. September 24 - Proposals must be received by the Sonoran Joint Venture no later than midnight, Pacific Daylight time.

amount.quote: Individual SJV Awards Program grants range from $5,000-$10,000, and we anticipate funding four to six awards in 2026.
